attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Image1 original small card is sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light and crop; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion. Only human anatomy becomes smooth golden-yellow compact NEAR-ROUND mascot head/body, green-ringed black eyes, source-matching mouth. Preserve real source hair, brows, conditional facial hair, clothes. Retain BAREHEADED thick DARK BROWN/BLACK high brushed-back/wavy hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin with no distinct moustache/beard, serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles/cap. Preserve DARK NAVY/CHARCOAL OPEN civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK GREY/BLACK subtly diagonal-pattern necktie area beside note. A clearly ROUNDED SHORT U-SHAPED lower yellow head, never a long pointed V-shaped jaw, immediately meets raised/broadened existing neckline, VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping or cream belly bib. Preserve actual open/closed garment and fastening, coherent front/rear collar overlap/contact shadow. Retain complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces opaque, alpha only outside complete card silhouette. No invented insignia/text/accessories. Fine primary details indistinct stay understated. Keep actual mild primary angle/head roll, grey light and crop, no uniform or hidden accessories.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED thick DARK BROWN/BLACK high brushed-back/wavy hair and real dark eyebrow HAIR, clean understated upper lip/chin with no distinct moustache/beard, serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles/cap. DARK NAVY/CHARCOAL OPEN civilian suit, WHITE/PALE shirt collar and DARK GREY/BLACK subtly diagonal-pattern necktie area beside note. Fine primary upper-lip shadow genuinely indistinct stays understated. Keep actual mild primary angle/head roll, grey light and crop, no uniform or hidden accessories.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed unchanged primary and matched analysis context, raw fullsize, pair and white/cyan/alpha. Preserves thick dark swept/wavy hair and brows, understated clean upper lip/chin, serious closed mouth, open dark navy suit, pale shirt and dark diagonal patterned tie, primary mild image-left pose. Reject pointed elongated yellow lower face at narrow shirt opening; require compact rounded short chin and raised broad collar without changing primary pose or inventing moustache/beard. Frame, backing, paper and dark cloth are opaque without visible cyan bleed.
